why: audit M2/1 F-M2-09 closes the free-text rebinding channel this I2 test exercised: since the I10 lifecycle is enforced, holon bind --accept-change alone no longer changes an existing binding; it needs an accepted laws/STATEMENT_DIFF.jsonl entry covering the law (here a binding_change, which needs a signature until an equivalence generator exists). The test keeps every I2 assertion (the unreasoned rebind is refused and names L_tag_BVH; the logged reason, laws and defs; G2 passes after the rebind) and now also asserts that the reason alone is refused, then appends a binding_change entry signed with a key made for the test in its throwaway copy (new helper signed_binding_change), and checks the log line names that entry (covered_by)
